parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Harness/PlayerControllerTestHarness.swift`. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is a test fixture must be treated as intentional duplication. Here both methods — `PlayerControllerTestHarness.postInterruptionBegan` (line 353) and `PlayerControllerTestHarness.postInterruptionEnded` (line 367) — are test-harness helpers whose structural similarity (Jaccard 0.83) almost certainly reflects the symmetric nature of interruption lifecycle events rather than an accidental copy. Merging them into a generic function would couple test infrastructure to a parameterisation that obscures the distinct semantic intent of each interruption phase.
